description: This Java class 'RetrieveFeatureDefinitionStrategy' handles the retrieval of feature definitions within a 'Thing' object, implementing command handling logic for the 'RetrieveFeatureDefinition' command, including extracting features, generating responses, and managing entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: Immutable class that implements strategy for retrieving feature definitions in a Thing, extending AbstractThingCommandStrategy for command handling.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main method to process the command, extract feature from the Thing, and generate a result with the feature definition or an error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Helper method to extract a specific feature from the Thing based on feature ID.

methods.name: getFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Generates a result containing the feature definition or an error if not found.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag based on command and previous entity state.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Determines the next entity tag for the new entity, based on the feature definition.
